div.head: Hn com Inscr.
div.ab: Carta eiusdem ubi comitatus teneri debet et ubi placita de divisis terrarum.
Order of Henry regarding the places where the County Court and cases concerning the division of lands ought to be held.
div.note: Added October 2026 from Robertson pp. 286–287 (text and translation); Liebermann’s text (K–M) not yet added; F: corrected against Liebermann, Gesetze I (date in the running heads); Wormald, Making of English Law I, October 2026 (was “1109–11; Reading (Robertson)”, now “1109–11 (Liebermann); 1108 (Wormald); Reading (Robertson)”); F: corrected against Liebermann, Gesetze I (date at the head of the text); Wormald, Making of English Law I; Whitelock, English Historical Documents I, October 2026 (was “1109–11 (Liebermann); 1108 (Wormald); Reading (Robertson)”, now “1109–11 (Liebermann, I p. 524); 1108 (Wormald, MEL p. 401); Reading (Robertson)”); V: page of the modern editor’s text / translation, checked against Robertson (translation on the facing page), October 2026 (e.g. was “286”, now “286 / 287”; 11 rows of Hn com)
